# External evaluation restarts: testing Manager on mathematics, knowledge and instruction following

After restoring access to the Mac mini, we evaluated the same SmolLM2 base and Manager Pilot005. IFEval: four prompts at the 1280-token cap, original Google scorer. MMLU-Pro: first 32 business-only viewer rows, two choice orders, 128 forward passes. MATH-500: 16 seed-42 sampled prompts from pinned revision 6e4ed1a2a79af7d8630a6b768ec859cb5af4d3be, greedy 256-token cap, adapted boxed extraction and upstream normalization.

| Task | Base | Pilot005 |
|---|---:|---:|
| IFEval strict prompt | 1/4 | 1/4 |
| MMLU-Pro direct-choice | 5/32 | 2/32 |
| MATH-500 boxed answer | 0/16 | 0/16 |

GPQA returned HTTP 401; no access bypass. These are exploratory subsets under distinct protocols, not full official leaderboard scores or evidence of statistical superiority. No new training, spending or production promotion.
